notes.title: "Monmusu Girls: Autobattler" is Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players,

The exciting moment has finally arrived! Monmusu Girls: Autobattler is now officially live on Steam! Welcome to this world full of strategy and adventure with monster girls![/p][p][/p][p]In a fantasy world, the Demon King's power awakens as monmusu girls' fates intertwine.[/p][p]As an adventuring party leader, recruit diverse monmusu girls with unique abilities to form a powerful team. Explore uncharted lands, unlock hidden stories, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Demon King's rise.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Strategic Team Composition, Easy to Play: With auto-battler mechanics, your success depends on how effectively you set up and combine your team.[/p][/*][*][p]Vast Character Collection, Infinite Possibilities: Collect a variety of monmusu girls, unlock their exclusive skills and bonds, and experiment with endless strategies.[/p][/*][*][p]Roguelike Elements, Making Every Adventure Unique: Encounter random events and rewards, ensuring each adventure presents a fresh and exciting challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Idle Gameplay, Rewards While You Rest: Even when offline, earn rewards to strengthen your team and evolve your girls into formidable warriors.[/p][/*][*][p]Immersive Fantasy World: As the story unfolds, dive deep into the demon world, meet new allies, and enjoy an engaging, fun-filled adventure.[/p][/*][/list][p]Redeem the codes below in the settings to claim your rewards:  [/p][list][*][p]Enter "[b]WELCOMETOMONMUSU[/b]" : AP (Stamina)*50 + Crystals*500  + Gold Coins*5000[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you to all players for your patience, valuable feedback, and enthusiastic support during development. It's because of your companionship that we've been able to bring this game to you. [/p][p][/p][p]Head over to Steam now and begin your monster girl adventure!

Love from
—Monmusu Autobattler Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432270/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: "Monmusu Girls: Autobattler" Demo Version Closure
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for being with us over the past four months. Your encouragement, feedback, and companionship have been the driving force behind our progress from the earliest test versions to where we are today.

As we prepare for the official launch, we will be closing the test server to focus on final preparations. All players who participated in the test will receive a special reward when the game officially launches — a small token of our heartfelt gratitude.

This chapter ends here, but the real adventure is just about to begin.

See you at launch!

Love from
—Monmusu Autobattler Dev Team

notes.title: "Monmusu Girls: Autobattler" SNF Wrap-Up & New Wipe Test Launch
notes.content:
Hello! Players!

A huge thank you to everyone who joined us at Steam Next Fest and shared your invaluable feedback—your suggestions and bug reports have helped us level up the game!

We're rolling out a maintenance update on March 5, 2025 (Thursday) at 22:00 PST, and we’re launching fresh round of testing. Please note: This is a wipe test, meaning all progress will be reset, giving everyone a clean slate to explore. Below are the details of this update:

[b]Maintenance Schedule[/b]
When: March 5, 2025, 22:00 – 23:00 (PST)

[b]Data Reset Notice[/b]
During maintenance, [color=#FF0000]all game data will be wiped[/color] . After the update, log in to start a new adventure!

[b]Testing Period[/b]
Duration: From the end of maintenance on March 5, 2025 until March 19 (PST)

[b]Test Details[/b]
This test is a [color=#FF0000]wipe test[/color] —progress made during this period won’t carry over after the test ends.

[b]Update Highlights[/b]
[olist][*] Increased the EXP provided when using armor for equipment upgrades.
[*] Adjusted the starting combat distance between both parties during battles.
[*] Fixed an issue where players used default avatars in the arena.
[*] Fixed the problem where guild battle boss HP was not carried over.
[*] Added maximum character limits to certain input fields.
[*] Added a new "Endless Tower" feature.
[*] Main story stages now consume stamina.
[*]  Fixed various interface display issues.
[*] Fixed battle sound effects that overlapped with settings controls.
[*]  Fixed the issue with challenge counts in the Chaos Realm.
[*] Fixed the issue with updating equipment in arena.
[*] Resolved some multilingual localization issues.
[*] Fixed the issue where enhancing equipment would use low-tier gear equipped by other teams[/olist]
[b]Friendly Reminder[/b]
We’d love to hear more of your thoughts during this testing phase. Your ongoing support and feedback are what keep us pushing forward!

Thank you for your passion and for being a part of the Monmusu Girls: Autobattler community. We can’t wait to see you in the game!

Cheers,
The Monmusu Girls: Autobattler Team

notes.title: The Demo Is Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Our game demo is now live, and we’re excited to announce that we’ll be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

Step into a world of magic and adventure, where the Demon King's power is awakening, and the fates of young heroines become entwined. You'll recruit unique monster girls, build a formidable team, explore uncharted lands, uncover hidden stories, and unravel the mysteries behind the Demon King’s return.

The demo features 40+ monster girls and 5 main story chapters to dive into!

The game currently supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and Thai, with French, German, Russian, and more coming in future updates.

We’d love to hear your thoughts after trying the demo—come share your experience with us!

Enjoy the game, and don’t forget to wishlist it on Steam!
